candidate.name: MCL One-Bar Auction Acceptance Relay
candidate.structural_change: hold maturation time at one completed bar and vary only categorical confirmation ownership

shared_lifecycle.raw_turn: close predecessor risk at the next MCL one-minute open and freeze a one-bar target
shared_lifecycle.maturation: evaluate exactly one further completed five-minute bar, then enter at the next MCL one-minute open or remain flat
shared_lifecycle.roll: close old MCL and wait flat for a fresh post-roll turn

bounded_cells.retained_state: raw turn requires velocity plus parity; second bar requires only retained target state
bounded_cells.retained_state_velocity: raw turn requires velocity plus parity; second bar requires retained state plus direction-aligned 30-minute velocity
bounded_cells.retained_state_parity: raw turn requires velocity plus parity; second bar requires retained state plus MCL parity
bounded_cells.emergent_financing: raw turn needs no financing; second bar requires retained state, direction-aligned 30-minute velocity, and MCL parity
bounded_cells.ranking: cadence eligibility, positive primary and stress month count, worst stress and primary month, stress net/intrabar-DD, stress PF, both directions, then primary net; validation cannot select

successor_law: If no cell clears cadence with stress-positive stable discovery, preserve strict v10 as a low-frequency reference and open a distinct failed-auction or curve-financing branch; do not tune the one-bar delay or numeric engine thresholds.
prohibitions: no crown without the missing first challenge year
